about: SANTE COSMETICS (the Dr.SANTE brand) is a Korean aesthetic brand with more than 20 years of history (since 2003). The company develops and manufactures professional skincare cosmetics, combining years of hands-on experience, professional expertise and a focus on skin health.
The brand's philosophy is skin health and beauty at the same time. The products are created for the professional segment and are designed for sensitive, dry, irritated and mature skin.

lines.name: Azulene Soother
lines.note: A soothing line with guaiazulene and chamomile water: it quickly reduces irritation, lowers skin temperature and strengthens the barrier, addressing the root causes of sensitive-skin concerns. Creams, serums, masks, lotions, mists, gels and sun-protection essences.

lines.name: Artemisia AKA
lines.note: A line for problem-prone and irritated skin with a pronounced soothing and anti-inflammatory action: ampoules, creams and masks for repair and barrier care.

lines.name: Collagen Leader
lines.note: Collagen-based care focused on firmness and mature skin.

lines.name: Hyalquad Core
lines.note: Intensive hydration based on a hyaluronic acid complex.

tech.name: Guaiazulene + chamomile water
tech.note: Real Blue Calming Solution — soothes irritated skin, lowers its temperature and strengthens the protective barrier.

tech.name: LHASOL™
tech.note: A proprietary 4th-generation keratolytic ingredient — stabilized LHA in high concentration; helps problem-prone skin return to a healthy, slightly acidic pH.

content.exportNote: Dr.SANTE products are supplied abroad, including the US and Japanese markets.

catalog_notes: A cleanser maintaining a mildly acidic pH 5.5 close to the healthiest skin state; hypoallergenic, moisturizing, soothing and reinforcing the skin barrier.
Gel product on a Chamomile flower water base. Quickly calms, cools and hydrates skin irritated by outdoor activity, sunlight, UV, heating or air conditioning.
Toner based on Chamomile flower extract and azulene instead of purified water, with 50,000 ppm Mt. Jirisan mint extract to soothe and hydrate; Aquaporin processing for deeper hydration.
Mildly acidic, hypoallergenic cleansing milk (pH 5.5) that removes daily makeup and even sunscreen, leaving a moisture barrier without tightness.
Lotion with real blue azulene on a Chamomile flower water base. Contains panthenol and ceramide NP; passed hypoallergenic tests for sensitive, infant and children skin.
Sun essence on a Chamomile flower water base with 11 types of hyaluronic acid; hydrates all day while protecting from UV. Sophora root extract soothes and preserves moisture.
Wash-off cream mask on Chamomile flower water with 1,000 ppm guaiazulene, 20,000 ppm dexpanthenol and 8 types of hyaluronic acid. Moisturizes, soothes and softens the skin.
Cream in the natural deep-blue azulene color with no artificial dyes. Strong soothing, moisture retention and protection, balancing water and oil for healthier skin.
Soothing Azulene Soother care in a compact stick format.
Biocellulose sheet mask, essence on 87% Chamomile flower water for quick soothing and hydration. 4th-generation restorative sheet adheres tightly and delivers active ingredients.
Non-drying gel modeling pack with 79% Chamomile flower water and azulene. Instantly soothes heated skin and reinforces the moisture barrier.
Ampoule for sensitive skin with a high azulene content well known among aesthetic brands. Strong soothing, moisture retention and protection.
Peeling serum with PHA and LHA on a Chamomile flower water base. Gently removes dead skin cells without irritation, moisturizes and adds glow.
Mist spray for genuine calming, relaxing, moisturizing and nourishing of tired and irritated skin.
Toner pads of gelated natural bamboo fiber. Gently adhere, prevent moisture loss and deliver active ingredients all day with a wrapping effect.
Refill for the Azulene Soother Semi-Gel Toner Pad.
Weakly acidic soothing toner that controls excess sebum and improves pores; suitable for daily use even on sensitive skin.
Face & neck semi-gel mask with strong anti-bacterial and anti-inflammatory action; quickly soothes skin and manages troubles.
Vegan pad from eco-friendly cotton and Tencel. Does not tear or stretch, adheres without irritation and absorbs toner into the skin.
Reliable top-grade jojoba oil from Israel, USDA-certified. Unrefined cold-pressed for higher antioxidant effect; its structure is close to the skin barrier and helps rebuild and reinforce it.
